welcome.title: Travel light with your Mi Band 9 Active
welcome.body: A single-device companion. No cloud. No tracking. Long battery life on both ends.

language.title: Pick your language
language.body: You can change this later in Settings.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth access
bluetooth.body: We need Bluetooth and nearby-devices to talk to your band. No location is collected.

notifications.title: Notification access
notifications.body: Forward chat, mail and calendar alerts to your band. You choose which apps later.

battery.title: Keep us awake
battery.body: Whitelist this app from battery optimization so syncs do not stall overnight.

scan.title: Find your band
scan.body: Wake your Mi Band 9 Active and bring it close. We will only show devices named “Xiaomi Smart Band 9 Active”.
scan.empty: Nothing found yet. Make sure the band is unpaired in Xiaomi Wear.

auth.title: Pair securely
auth.body: Paste the 32-byte auth key. We never send it off-device.

done.title: All set
done.body: Your band is paired. The first sync runs in the background.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.permissionBody: Grant access so we can forward alerts to the band.
notifications.muteDnd: Mute while phone is on Do Not Disturb

errors.authFailed: Pairing failed — check the auth key
